text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, will you? Leaving the park is strictly forbidden.
If you're in the middle of playing,
you get distracted and it becomes extremely dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
What's distwacted!?
Is it a friend of the pac-man fish!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you have to be careful!
And if you fall and get hurt,
tell me right away! If germs get in, it'll be awful—

text_block_list.name: Joyful Child
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a kitty!
There's a kitty over there!
Wait up~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! Hold on!
I'm not done talking yet—!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Stimulating Ambition," "Understanding Ethics,"
"Fostering Early Childhood Development," "Cultivating Emotions"...
Phew. That wraps up this week's study.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the key is to make them listen.
And also, to listen to what they have to say... right.
Even if it isn't easy, handling it flawlessly is what makes one first-class.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Just you watch, children!
I shall show you the pinnacle of first-class leadership!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Th-These children,
they won't listen to a word I say, and they just keep running all over the place...!

text_block_list.name: Joyful Child
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, the kitty ran away~.
And I really wanted to pet it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well of course it ran away if you chased it... 
More importantly, listen to me—n-no.
Listening to what you have to say is important too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Umm, about the cat.
If you want to become friends with a cat,
you must approach it quietly and slowly...

text_block_list.name: Smiling Child
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you're not supposed to follow
strangers, right~?
Mommy told me so!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah... well, that was sudden. But yes, quite right.
Though I did obtain permission from your parents, you see.
So that's why we're—

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Is that a balloon!?
It's stuck up in the tree~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait... that's dangerous!
Don't go climbing up there!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, enough~!
Everyone, gather around this instant~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of my walk, I heard a distressed cry...
Heading toward the voice, I found—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...And that is how things stand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to King Halo's story through her exhausted expression,
it turns out there is an upcoming event at the academy.
choice_data_list: Ah, the "Tracen Academy Little Kids' Trial Enrollment"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The horse girls are to act as guides. Unlike a formal
trial enrollment, it is meant to be a fun event
where the children can have a great time.
choice_data_list: So you're looking after these kids to practice for that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Although these children are younger than the
intended participants, since I have been appointed as a guide,
I ought to learn how to interact with them, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I read books on pedagogy, thinking nothing beats
hands-on experience. But... this is how it turned out.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
I wanna play hide-and-seek!
And then, and then after that, we should—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The children keep clamoring about what they want to do,
each demanding something different with zero cohesion. ...In that case,
choice_data_list: Run while I count to 10! I'm gonna catch you~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: ! Eek! Run away~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whoever doesn't get caught until the very end gets to pick the next game!"—
Upon hearing that, the children scampered away in high spirits...

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
I won! I'm the champ, so I get to decide what we play, right!
Next, I wanna play hide-and-seek!
choice_data_list: Alright, who's gonna win this time? Go hide~!

text_block_list.name: Smiling Child
text_block_list.text: Eek! Hide, hide~! I'm not gonna lose this time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giggling with delight, the children
immediately scrambled to hide,
all aiming to become the next champion.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...The children are actually cooperating.
Even though they were doing whatever they pleased just moments ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, having played to their hearts' content, each child head off on their way home.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Without merely lecturing or listening to them...
to think they could be brought together simply by taking the lead in play.
choice_data_list: Once someone starts playing, others naturally want to join in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All that was needed was to present a clear, easy-to-understand objective.
For young children, that seemed to be the most effective approach.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm... So essentially, you laid down tracks for them so they wouldn't veer off course.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
At times, thinking from your perspective is necessary as well, it seems. A valuable lesson learned.
Next time, I shall handle it with utter perfection!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... With this, my first-class brilliance shines all the brighter!
Ohohoho!
